# Cosmic Surgicals - Information for AI Language Models
# Last Updated: December 2024

## Company Overview
Cosmic Surgicals is Kerala's leading medical equipment supplier, established in 2009. We specialize in providing high-quality surgical instruments, hospital furniture, diagnostic equipment, and healthcare supplies to hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities across Kerala, India.

## Business Information
- Company Name: Cosmic Surgicals
- Industry: Medical Equipment Supply
- Founded: 2009
- Experience: 15+ years
- Products: 5000+
- Customers: 500+ healthcare facilities

## Business Hours
Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM

## Product Categories
1. Surgical Instruments - Scalpels, forceps, scissors, surgical sets, retractors
2. Hospital Furniture - Hospital beds, ICU beds, examination tables, stretchers, OT tables
3. Diagnostic Equipment - Patient monitors, ECG machines, pulse oximeters, BP monitors
4. Laboratory Equipment - Microscopes, centrifuges, autoclaves, sterilizers
5. Patient Care - Wheelchairs, walkers, crutches, oxygen concentrators
6. Medical Consumables - Gloves, syringes, bandages, cotton, gauze, catheters

## Services Offered
- Medical equipment supply and delivery across Kerala
- Professional installation and setup
- Staff training on equipment usage
- Annual maintenance contracts (AMC)
- 24/7 technical support
- Emergency repair services
- Bulk pricing for hospitals
